name: Eldora's Crossing
title: Republic of the Silver Ford
overview: A thriving mercantile city built where the Silverflow River narrows into a natural ford, the primary crossing for trade between the northern kingdoms and the southern merchant republics. Stacked warehouses line the dockside while noble estates crown the eastern bluffs.
history: Founded 300 years ago by the merchant lord Eldora as a trading post, the city has grown into a regional power. The original stone keep still stands in the center, now housing the guilds' offices.
current_ruler_sentence: A council of guild masters governs by uneasy consensus, its chair rotating each season.
social_history: Old dock families and newer guild money circle each other warily across the bluffs and the wharves.
economic_history: Tariffs on the ford built the city's wealth; smuggling routes beneath the cisterns quietly erode it.
military_history: A standing harbor watch and hired caravan guards stand in for any real army the republic never raised.
central_dynamic: Guild ambition versus dock-family tradition, with the failing cisterns forcing both to act.
present_state: A shipment of rare reagents has vanished from the docks while the aging water cisterns spring fresh breaches.
where_it_sits: At the narrowest ford of the Silverflow, between the northern kingdoms and the southern republics.
extent: The walled city and its terraced bluffs, plus the ford and warehouse flats along both banks.
features: A stone keep, tiered guild halls, dockside warehouses, and a labyrinth of underground cisterns.
what_happens_here: Caravans are bonded, cargo is taxed, and contraband changes hands in the small hours.
what_lives_here: Merchants, dock crews, guild factors, and the smugglers who work the cisterns below.
travel_and_hazards: The ford is safe by day; the warehouse district turns dangerous after dark.
who_frequents_here: Caravan masters, guild factors, river pilots, and informants for every faction.
hidden_detail: A sealed cistern gate hides the original smugglers' dock beneath the merchant quarter.

npc_list.name: Guildmaster Veyra
npc_list.description: The sharp-eyed chair of the merchant council, balancing dock families against newer guild money.
